user.title: Add a folder
user.description: Monitor the size and contents of a folder. The folder must be listed under `allowlist_external_dirs` in your configuration.yaml.

data_description.folder: Full path to the folder to monitor, for example /media/downloads.
data_description.filter: Glob pattern used to select files, for example *.mp4. Use * for all files.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the folder is scanned, in seconds.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure folder
reconfigure.description: Change the folder being monitored and how it is scanned.

data_description.folder: Full path to the folder to monitor, for example /media/downloads.
data_description.filter: Glob pattern used to select files, for example *.mp4. Use * for all files.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the folder is scanned, in seconds.

error.not_dir: That path does not exist or is not a folder.
error.not_allowed: That folder is not allowed. Add it to `allowlist_external_dirs` in configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.

abort.invalid_path: The imported configuration has no folder path.
abort.not_dir: The imported folder does not exist or is not a folder.
abort.not_allowed: The imported folder is not in `allowlist_external_dirs`.

data_description.filter: Glob pattern used to select files, for example *.mp4. Use * for all files.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the folder is scanned, in seconds.

deprecated_yaml.title: The folder YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: Configuring folder sensors in configuration.yaml is deprecated. The folder `{path}` has been imported into the UI automatically. Remove the `folder` sensor platform from your configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
